About the host

Zack Tarbet is a Loan Officer with OriginPoint, working with buyers, veterans, and real estate agents on purchase and refinance financing. These sessions are education, not a sales pitch. Come with questions.

Every class is held live on Zoom. Register once and you will get the link by email, plus a reminder before it starts. If you cannot make it live, register anyway and we will send you the recording.

What to expect

  • 45 minutes, start on time, end on time
  • Live Q&A at the end
  • No cost, no obligation
  • Recording sent to everyone who registers
